facts.text: The README describes a deep reinforcement learning environment in Ignition Gazebo for a UR5 arm with an RG2 gripper
The README tells the user to install Ignition Gazebo before installing the package
setup.cfg install_requires lists gym-ignition and numpy
requirements.txt pins gym~=0.21.0, numpy~=1.22.3 and scipy~=1.8.0
The package imports register from gym.envs.registration, the legacy Gym 0.21 API
ReachUR5-v0 is registered with entry_point gym_ignition.runtimes.gazebo_runtime:GazeboRuntime, max_episode_steps 100, agent_rate 2.5, physics_rate 100.0 and real_time_factor max_float
ReachDictUR5-v0 and PickAndPlaceUR5-v0 are also registered with max_episode_steps 50 and different task classes; this package serves ReachUR5-v0 only
gym_ur5.tasks.reach defines Reach(task.Task, abc.ABC)
The workspace centre is [0.50143738, 0.15, 1.36] and the workspace volume is [0.4, 0.4, 0.4]
The action space is Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(3,), float32) and the observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=(6,), float32)
set_action adds action * 0.1 to the end-effector position and clamps every coordinate to the workspace centre +- half the volume
get_observation returns the end-effector position concatenated with the target position, six values
get_reward returns +1.0 when the distance to the target is below 0.05 and -1.0 otherwise
get_info returns is_success True when the distance to the target is at most 0.05
is_done returns the task's _is_done flag
reset_task clears _is_done and sets the eight joint position targets to the fixed configuration [1.47838380, -2.15699582, -0.000081469105, -2.52916159, 1.56735617, -0.0925439234, 0, 0]
get_joints returns the six arm joints and the two RG2 finger joints
get_target_position returns the base position of the RedPoint model
get_ee_position returns the world position of the model's tool0 link
The randomizer inserts the UR5RG2 model at [0.5, 0.5, 1.02] when the scene has no ur5_rg2 model
The workspace random target is drawn uniformly from the workspace box with numpy's global generator
The UR5 has six arm joints with limits +-6.28319 rad and the RG2 two finger joints with limits 0 to 0.52359878 rad

determinism.notes: cap.world.seed.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 accept a seed and the driver echoes it; the fake is deterministic and repeats a trajectory, but its start position and target are fixed placeholder test data, so a different seed does not change the scene.  Upstream the randomizer draws the RedPoint target from numpy's global generator (reach.py:167-171), so a seeded run there can differ; this package never ran the upstream environment

fidelity.engine: gym-ignition:ReachUR5-v0 (Ignition Gazebo; the package serves the task class with a kinematic fake)
gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in, not Ignition Gazebo: it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, joint controllers, inverse kinematics, gravity, friction or model assets, and it was not compared with an Ignition run; one tick applies the task's action arithmetic (reach.py:50-74) to a point end effector

the start position and the RedPoint target are fixed placeholder test data in the fake, not a simulation of the upstream randomizer; a seed is accepted and echoed but does not change the fake's scene, and the seeded determinism claim is therefore not exercised by this package

the upstream environment is the legacy Gym 0.21 API (requirements.txt:1) whose registered entry point is gym_ignition.runtimes.gazebo_runtime:GazeboRuntime; this driver serves the in-clone task class directly and replicates the TimeLimit at max_episode_steps=100 in step(), not the Gym wrappers (PassiveEnvChecker, OrderEnforcing, render mode)
the observation is six Python floats (end-effector position followed by target position, reach.py:76-81); upstream returns a float32 numpy array of the same six values

the task's set_action calls inverse kinematics and set_joint_position_targets (reach.py:67-72); the fake moves the end-effector point directly and does not model the UR5 joints, the RG2 fingers, the table, the cube or the RedPoint asset downloads
no rendering, no camera or image, no Fuel asset download and no network path is served; nothing was validated against a real UR5 or RG2 gripper

ReachDictUR5-v0 and PickAndPlaceUR5-v0 are NOT COVERED: their dict observations (reach_dict.py:45-57) and pick-and-place state, finger actions and cube respawn (pick_and_place.py:37-57, :59-82, :84-104, :260-282) are not served by this package
snapshot and restore are not offered: the task class exposes no get_state/set_state, so snapshot_restore is false
